attestations.text: SUN Yüan-hsiang 孫原湘 (T. 子瀟, H. 心清), Dec. 17, 1760–1829, Mar. 6, poet, was a native of Chao-wên, Kiangsu. He began seriously to write verse after he married in 1776 the poetess, Hsi P'ei-lan 席佩蘭 (T. 韻芬, 道華, H. 浣雲).
